title: arachnorchis pholcoidea subsp. augustensis
intro: Arachnorchis pholcoidea subsp. augustensis, commonly known as the August Spider Orchid, is a rare and endemic species of orchid found in Western Australia. This plant is a type of epiphytic orchid, meaning it grows on other plants or trees without deriving nutrients from them. The August Spider Orchid has been traditionally used in Western Australian Aboriginal medicine, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Arachnorchis pholcoidea subsp. augustensis include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory actions, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids.
